name: Iqura Siddiqui
title: Operations & Quality Professional
tagline: Strengthening quality, compliance, and reporting through careful analysis and practical process improvement.
summary: Operations and Quality professional with 10+ years of experience in quality control, data analysis, compliance, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder coordination. Experienced in high-volume quality and procurement activities, maintaining audit-ready records, and improving operational processes. Skilled in Advanced Excel, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and generative AI tools, with a strong interest in using AI and automation to improve reporting, documentation, and business processes.

experience.title: Quality Control Inspector

Completed procurement of more than 3,000 metric tonnes of food grains under the Government of India Direct Benefit Scheme.
Maintained quality records, compliance databases, inspection reports, and stock documentation to support traceability and audit readiness.
Monitored moisture, purity, damage, contamination, infestation, and spoilage, escalating issues to relevant stakeholders.
Prepared quality and compliance reports and coordinated with internal teams, warehouse personnel, and external stakeholders.
Supported internal and external audits and process-improvement initiatives while maintaining regulatory documentation.
Used Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and other generative AI tools to support reporting, documentation, data analysis, presentations, and professional communications.
